svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — Residual
svg.desc: Solid paths carry residuals or sublayer outputs; dashed paths carry the next read gate or point from the backbone to its expanded layer. Mixing acts across streams at each token, never across token positions. Engram updates preserve this state contract; dSpark observes separate mean-stream taps.
